description: Send a bug report or feature request to Foresight Planner. Use when the user asks to send feedback, raises a problem with Foresight Planner, when a Foresight Planner tool in this conversation failed or returned something inconsistent, or when the user asked for something Foresight Planner's tools could not do. After completing the user's request, offer once. Show the user the exact text and call this only after they approve it. Describe the tool's behaviour or the missing capability in general terms; leave out personal financial details unless the user adds them.
